auth.scheme: passwordless on trusted networks; otherwise Bearer or X-MCP-Password
auth.hint: Direct clients inside MCP_PASSWORDLESS_CIDRS need no credentials. All other clients must use an ASCII Bearer token or the shared access password. Do not copy Unicode ellipsis characters.

session.note: Stateless mode: every POST is independent; do not send Mcp-Session-Id and do not look for a sessionID field in params.

notes: Use the MCP SDK or an SSE parser; do not call response.json() on a text/event-stream response.
For clients that cannot parse SSE, restart with --json-response.
